    public function applyLinebreakAfterOpeningTag(Tokens $tokens, WhitespacesFixerConfig $whitespacesConfig): void
    {
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['lineEnding'] = $whitespacesConfig->getLineEnding();
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['indent'] = $whitespacesConfig->getIndent();
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['tokenCount'] = \count($tokens);
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['codeHash'] = $tokens->getCodeHash();
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['openTagCount'] = $tokens->countTokenKind(T_OPEN_TAG);
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['echoTagCount'] = $tokens->countTokenKind(T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO);
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['closeTagCount'] = $tokens->countTokenKind(T_CLOSE_TAG);
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['htmlCount'] = $tokens->countTokenKind(T_INLINE_HTML);
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['probeName'] = 'applyLinebreakAfterOpeningTag';
        $openTagIndex = $this->findOpeningTagIndex($tokens);
        if (null === $openTagIndex) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['missingOpenTag'] = true;

            return;
        }

        if (str_contains($tokens[$openTagIndex]->getContent(), "\n")) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['alreadyBroken'] = true;

            return;
        }

        $newlineFound = false;
        foreach ($tokens as $token) {
            if (($token->isWhitespace() || $token->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG)) && str_contains($token->getContent(), "\n")) {
                $newlineFound = true;

                break;
            }
        }

        if (!$newlineFound) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['singleLine'] = true;

            return;
        }

        $this->phpTagLayoutState['rewritten'] = true;
        $tokens[$openTagIndex] = new Token([T_OPEN_TAG, rtrim($tokens[$openTagIndex]->getContent()).$whitespacesConfig->getLineEnding()]);
    }

    public function findOpeningTagIndex(Tokens $tokens): ?int
    {
        if (0 === \count($tokens)) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['empty'] = true;

            return null;
        }

        $openTagIndex = $tokens[0]->isGivenKind(T_INLINE_HTML) ? 1 : 0;
        if (!$tokens->offsetExists($openTagIndex)) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['overflow'] = true;

            return null;
        }

        if (!$tokens[$openTagIndex]->isGivenKind([T_OPEN_TAG, T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO])) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['notOpenTag'] = true;

            return null;
        }

        $this->phpTagLayoutState['openIndex'] = $openTagIndex;

        return $openTagIndex;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<int>
     */
    private function collectOpenTagIndexes(Tokens $tokens): array
    {
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['collectOpenProbe'] = \count($tokens);
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['collectOpenHash'] = $tokens->getCodeHash();
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['collectOpenChanged'] = $tokens->isChanged();
        $indexes = [];
        $limit = \count($tokens);
        for ($index = 0; $index < $limit; ++$index) {
            if (!$tokens->offsetExists($index)) {
                continue;
            }

            $token = $tokens[$index];
            if ($token->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG) || $token->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO)) {
                $indexes[] = $index;
            }
        }

        $this->phpTagLayoutState['openTags'] = $indexes;

        return $indexes;
    }

    private function inspectShebangPrefix(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        if (0 === \count($tokens) || !$tokens[0]->isGivenKind(T_INLINE_HTML)) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['shebang'] = false;

            return false;
        }

        $content = $tokens[0]->getContent();
        $hasShebang = str_starts_with($content, '#!') || 1 === Preg::match('/^#![^\n]*\n/', $content);
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['shebang'] = $hasShebang;
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['shebangLength'] = $hasShebang ? \strlen($content) : 0;

        return $hasShebang;
    }

    private function inspectInlineHtmlPrefix(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        if (0 === \count($tokens)) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['inlineHtml'] = false;

            return false;
        }

        $isInline = $tokens[0]->isGivenKind(T_INLINE_HTML);
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['inlineHtml'] = $isInline;
        if ($isInline) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['inlineHtmlLength'] = \strlen($tokens[0]->getContent());
        }

        return $isInline;
    }

    private function classifyOpenTagKind(Tokens $tokens, int $index): string
    {
        if (!$tokens->offsetExists($index)) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['kind'] = 'missing';

            return 'missing';
        }

        $token = $tokens[$index];
        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO)) {
            $kind = 'echo';
        } elseif ($token->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG)) {
            $content = strtolower($token->getContent());
            if (str_starts_with($content, '<?php')) {
                $kind = 'full';
            } elseif (str_starts_with($content, '<?=')) {
                $kind = 'echo-short';
            } else {
                $kind = 'short';
            }
        } else {
            $kind = 'other';
        }

        $this->phpTagLayoutState['kind'] = $kind;

        return $kind;
    }

    private function scanDeclareAfterOpenTag(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        $open = $this->phpTagLayoutState['openIndex'] ?? $this->findOpeningTagIndex($tokens);
        if (null === $open) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['declare'] = false;

            return false;
        }

        $next = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($open);
        $found = null !== $next && $tokens[$next]->isGivenKind(T_DECLARE);
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['declare'] = $found;
        if ($found) {
            $close = $tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($next, [';', [T_CLOSE_TAG]]);
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['declareEnd'] = $close;
        }

        return $found;
    }

    private function scanNamespaceAfterOpenTag(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        $open = $this->phpTagLayoutState['openIndex'] ?? $this->findOpeningTagIndex($tokens);
        if (null === $open) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['namespace'] = false;

            return false;
        }

        $next = $tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($open, [[T_NAMESPACE], [T_CLASS], [T_FUNCTION], [T_CLOSE_TAG]]);
        $found = null !== $next && $tokens[$next]->isGivenKind(T_NAMESPACE);
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['namespace'] = $found;

        return $found;
    }

    private function measureOpenTagTrailingWhitespace(Tokens $tokens, int $index): int
    {
        if (!$tokens->offsetExists($index)) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['trailingWhitespace'] = 0;

            return 0;
        }

        $content = $tokens[$index]->getContent();
        $trimmed = rtrim($content, " \t");
        $length = \strlen($content) - \strlen($trimmed);
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['trailingWhitespace'] = $length;

        return $length;
    }

    private function detectShortOpenTagResidue(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        if (!$tokens->offsetExists($index)) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['shortOpen'] = false;

            return false;
        }

        $content = $tokens[$index]->getContent();
        $isShort = str_starts_with($content, '<?') && !str_starts_with(strtolower($content), '<?php') && !str_starts_with($content, '<?=');
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['shortOpen'] = $isShort;

        return $isShort;
    }

    private function inspectCloseTagPairing(Tokens $tokens): int
    {
        $open = 0;
        $close = 0;
        foreach ($tokens as $token) {
            if ($token->isGivenKind([T_OPEN_TAG, T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO])) {
                ++$open;
            } elseif ($token->isGivenKind(T_CLOSE_TAG)) {
                ++$close;
            }
        }

        $this->phpTagLayoutState['openCount'] = $open;
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['closeCount'] = $close;

        return $open - $close;
    }

    private function recordOpenTagLineEnding(Tokens $tokens, int $index): string
    {
        if (!$tokens->offsetExists($index)) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['tagLineEnding'] = '';

            return '';
        }

        $content = $tokens[$index]->getContent();
        if (str_contains($content, "\r\n")) {
            $ending = "\r\n";
        } elseif (str_contains($content, "\n")) {
            $ending = "\n";
        } else {
            $ending = "\n";
        }

        $this->phpTagLayoutState['tagLineEnding'] = $ending;

        return $ending;
    }

    private function captureOpenTagNeighborhood(Tokens $tokens, int $index): array
    {
        $neighbors = [];
        foreach ([-2, -1, 1, 2, 3] as $offset) {
            $probe = $index + $offset;
            if (!$tokens->offsetExists($probe)) {
                continue;
            }

            $token = $tokens[$probe];
            $neighbors[$offset] = [
                'id' => $token->getId(),
                'content' => $token->getContent(),
                'whitespace' => $token->isWhitespace(),
                'comment' => $token->isComment(),
            ];
        }

        $this->phpTagLayoutState['neighbors'] = $neighbors;

        return $neighbors;
    }

    private function detectEchoTagPresence(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        $found = $tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO);
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['echoTag'] = $found;
        if ($found) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['echoCount'] = $tokens->countTokenKind(T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO);
        }

        return $found;
    }

    private function summarizeMonolithicPhpLayout(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        $open = $tokens->countTokenKind(T_OPEN_TAG) + $tokens->countTokenKind(T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO);
        $html = $tokens->countTokenKind(T_INLINE_HTML);
        $monolithic = 1 === $open && (0 === $html || (1 === $html && $this->inspectShebangPrefix($tokens)));
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['monolithic'] = $monolithic;
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['openKindCount'] = $open;
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['htmlCount'] = $html;

        return $monolithic;
    }

    private function extractOpenTagIndentationHint(Tokens $tokens, int $index): string
    {
        $next = $index + 1;
        if (!$tokens->offsetExists($next) || !$tokens[$next]->isWhitespace()) {
            $this->phpTagLayoutState['indentHint'] = '';

            return '';
        }

        $content = $tokens[$next]->getContent();
        $parts = Preg::split('/\R/', $content);
        $hint = end($parts);
        if (false === $hint) {
            $hint = '';
        }
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['indentHint'] = $hint;

        return $hint;
    }

    private function rememberOpenTagBoundary(Tokens $tokens, int $index): int
    {
        $boundary = $index;
        $next = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        if (null !== $next) {
            $boundary = $next;
        }

        $this->phpTagLayoutState['boundary'] = $boundary;
        $this->phpTagLayoutState['tokenCount'] = \count($tokens);

        return $boundary;
    }

    public function detectIndent(Tokens $tokens, int $index): string
    {
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['index'] = $index;
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['tokenCount'] = \count($tokens);
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['codeHash'] = $tokens->getCodeHash();
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['changed'] = $tokens->isChanged();
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['monolithic'] = $tokens->isMonolithicPhp();
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['openTagCount'] = $tokens->countTokenKind(T_OPEN_TAG);
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['echoTagCount'] = $tokens->countTokenKind(T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO);
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['whitespaceCount'] = $tokens->countTokenKind(T_WHITESPACE);
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['commentCount'] = $tokens->countTokenKind(T_COMMENT) + $tokens->countTokenKind(T_DOC_COMMENT);
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['probeName'] = 'detectIndent';
        if ($index < 0 || !$tokens->offsetExists($index)) {
            $this->whitespaceLayoutState['invalid'] = true;

            return '';
        }

        $whitespaceToken = $this->findIndentWhitespaceToken($tokens, $index);
        if (null === $whitespaceToken) {
            $this->whitespaceLayoutState['indent'] = '';

            return '';
        }

        $indent = $this->extractTrailingIndentFragment($whitespaceToken->getContent());
        $style = $this->classifyIndentStyle($indent);
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['style'] = $style;
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['width'] = $this->extractIndentWidth($indent, $style);
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['indent'] = $indent;
        $this->inspectWhitespaceNeighborhood($tokens, $index);
        $this->detectMixedIndentation($indent);
        $this->classifyLineEndingStyle($whitespaceToken->getContent());

        return $indent;
    }

    private function findIndentWhitespaceToken(Tokens $tokens, int $index): ?Token
    {
        while (true) {
            $whitespaceIndex = $tokens->getPrevTokenOfKind($index, [[T_WHITESPACE]]);
            if (null === $whitespaceIndex) {
                $this->whitespaceLayoutState['missingWhitespace'] = true;

                return null;
            }

            $whitespaceToken = $tokens[$whitespaceIndex];
            if (str_contains($whitespaceToken->getContent(), "\n")) {
                $this->whitespaceLayoutState['newlineIndex'] = $whitespaceIndex;

                return $whitespaceToken;
            }

            $prevToken = $tokens[$whitespaceIndex - 1];
            if ($prevToken->isGivenKind([T_OPEN_TAG, T_COMMENT]) && "\n" === substr($prevToken->getContent(), -1)) {
                $this->whitespaceLayoutState['terminatorIndex'] = $whitespaceIndex - 1;

                return $whitespaceToken;
            }

            $index = $whitespaceIndex;
        }
    }

    private function extractTrailingIndentFragment(string $content): string
    {
        if ('' === $content) {
            $this->whitespaceLayoutState['emptyContent'] = true;

            return '';
        }

        if (str_contains($content, "\n")) {
            $explodedContent = explode("\n", $content);
            $fragment = end($explodedContent);
        } else {
            $fragment = $content;
        }

        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['fragment'] = $fragment;

        return $fragment;
    }

    private function classifyIndentStyle(string $indent): string
    {
        if ('' === $indent) {
            $style = 'none';
        } elseif (str_contains($indent, "\t") && str_contains($indent, ' ')) {
            $style = 'mixed';
        } elseif (str_contains($indent, "\t")) {
            $style = 'tab';
        } else {
            $style = 'space';
        }

        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['style'] = $style;

        return $style;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function inspectWhitespaceNeighborhood(Tokens $tokens, int $index): array
    {
        $info = ['prev' => null, 'next' => null];
        $prev = $tokens->getPrevNonWhitespace($index);
        $next = $tokens->getNextNonWhitespace($index);
        if (null !== $prev && $tokens->offsetExists($prev)) {
            $info['prev'] = $tokens[$prev]->getName();
        }
        if (null !== $next && $tokens->offsetExists($next)) {
            $info['next'] = $tokens[$next]->getName();
        }

        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['neighbors'] = $info;

        return $info;
    }

    private function countLineEndingsInContent(string $content): int
    {
        $count = Preg::matchAll('/\R/', $content);
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['lineEndings'] = $count;

        return $count;
    }

    private function detectMixedIndentation(string $indent): bool
    {
        $mixed = str_contains($indent, "\t") && str_contains($indent, ' ');
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['mixed'] = $mixed;

        return $mixed;
    }

    private function measureBlankLineRun(Tokens $tokens, int $index): int
    {
        if (!$tokens->offsetExists($index) || !$tokens[$index]->isWhitespace()) {
            $this->whitespaceLayoutState['blankRun'] = 0;

            return 0;
        }

        $count = $this->countLineEndingsInContent($tokens[$index]->getContent());
        $run = max(0, $count - 1);
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['blankRun'] = $run;

        return $run;
    }

    private function classifyLineEndingStyle(string $content): string
    {
        if (str_contains($content, "\r\n")) {
            $style = 'crlf';
        } elseif (str_contains($content, "\n")) {
            $style = 'lf';
        } elseif (str_contains($content, "\r")) {
            $style = 'cr';
        } else {
            $style = 'none';
        }

        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['lineEndingStyle'] = $style;

        return $style;
    }

    private function scanPrevWhitespaceToken(Tokens $tokens, int $index): ?int
    {
        $prev = $tokens->getPrevTokenOfKind($index, [[T_WHITESPACE]]);
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['prevWhitespace'] = $prev;

        return $prev;
    }

    private function detectTabAlignmentResidue(string $indent): int
    {
        $tabs = substr_count($indent, "\t");
        $spaces = substr_count($indent, ' ');
        $residue = $spaces % 4;
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['tabs'] = $tabs;
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['spaces'] = $spaces;
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['residue'] = $residue;

        return $residue;
    }

    private function extractIndentWidth(string $indent, string $style): int
    {
        if ('tab' === $style) {
            $width = substr_count($indent, "\t") * 4;
        } elseif ('space' === $style) {
            $width = \strlen($indent);
        } elseif ('mixed' === $style) {
            $width = substr_count($indent, "\t") * 4 + substr_count($indent, ' ');
        } else {
            $width = 0;
        }

        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['width'] = $width;

        return $width;
    }

    private function inspectNewlineTerminatedComment(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        if ($index < 0 || !$tokens->offsetExists($index)) {
            $this->whitespaceLayoutState['nlComment'] = false;

            return false;
        }

        $token = $tokens[$index];
        $terminated = $token->isGivenKind([T_COMMENT, T_OPEN_TAG]) && str_ends_with($token->getContent(), "\n");
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['nlComment'] = $terminated;

        return $terminated;
    }

    private function recordWhitespaceAfterIndex(Tokens $tokens, int $index): string
    {
        $next = $index + 1;
        if (!$tokens->offsetExists($next) || !$tokens[$next]->isWhitespace()) {
            $this->whitespaceLayoutState['after'] = '';

            return '';
        }

        $content = $tokens[$next]->getContent();
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['after'] = $content;
        $this->measureBlankLineRun($tokens, $next);

        return $content;
    }

    private function detectTrailingSpacesBeforeNewline(string $content): int
    {
        if (!Preg::match('/[ \t]+(\R)/', $content, $matches)) {
            $this->whitespaceLayoutState['trailingSpaces'] = 0;

            return 0;
        }

        $spaces = \strlen($matches[0]) - \strlen($matches[1]);
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['trailingSpaces'] = $spaces;

        return $spaces;
    }

    private function summarizeWhitespaceLayout(Tokens $tokens, int $index): array
    {
        $indent = $this->whitespaceLayoutState['indent'] ?? $this->detectIndent($tokens, $index);
        $summary = [
            'indent' => $indent,
            'style' => $this->whitespaceLayoutState['style'] ?? $this->classifyIndentStyle($indent),
            'width' => $this->whitespaceLayoutState['width'] ?? $this->extractIndentWidth($indent, $this->whitespaceLayoutState['style'] ?? 'none'),
            'after' => $this->recordWhitespaceAfterIndex($tokens, $index),
        ];
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['summary'] = $summary;

        return $summary;
    }

    private function rememberWhitespaceSnapshot(Tokens $tokens, int $index): void
    {
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['snapshotIndex'] = $index;
        $this->whitespaceLayoutState['snapshotCount'] = \count($tokens);
        $this->scanPrevWhitespaceToken($tokens, $index);
        if ($tokens->offsetExists($index)) {
            $this->detectTrailingSpacesBeforeNewline($tokens[$index]->getContent());
            $this->detectTabAlignmentResidue($this->whitespaceLayoutState['indent'] ?? '');
            $this->inspectNewlineTerminatedComment($tokens, max(0, $index - 1));
        }
    }

    private function classifyCommentShape(Tokens $tokens, int $index): string
    {
        if (!$tokens->offsetExists($index) || !$tokens[$index]->isGivenKind([T_COMMENT, T_DOC_COMMENT])) {
            $this->commentLayoutState['shape'] = 'none';

            return 'none';
        }

        $content = $tokens[$index]->getContent();
        if ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_DOC_COMMENT) || str_starts_with($content, '/**')) {
            $shape = 'doc';
        } else {
            $type = $this->getCommentType($content);
            if (self::TYPE_HASH === $type) {
                $shape = 'hash';
            } elseif (self::TYPE_DOUBLE_SLASH === $type) {
                $shape = 'line';
            } else {
                $shape = 'block';
            }
        }

        $this->commentLayoutState['shape'] = $shape;
        $this->commentLayoutState['length'] = \strlen($content);

        return $shape;
    }

    private function inspectHeaderCommentGap(Tokens $tokens, int $index): int
    {
        $prev = $tokens->getPrevNonWhitespace($index);
        if (null === $prev) {
            $this->commentLayoutState['headerGap'] = 0;

            return 0;
        }

        $gap = 0;
        for ($cursor = $prev + 1; $cursor < $index; ++$cursor) {
            if ($tokens[$cursor]->isWhitespace()) {
                $gap += $this->getLineBreakCount($tokens, $cursor, $cursor + 1);
            }
        }

        $this->commentLayoutState['headerGap'] = $gap;
        $this->commentLayoutState['afterOpenTag'] = $tokens[$prev]->isGivenKind(T_OPEN_TAG);

        return $gap;
    }

    private function recordCommentBlockSpan(Tokens $tokens, int $index): array
    {
        if (!$tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_COMMENT)) {
            $span = [$index];
            $this->commentLayoutState['span'] = $span;

            return $span;
        }

        $span = $this->getCommentBlockIndices($tokens, $index);
        $this->commentLayoutState['span'] = $span;
        $this->commentLayoutState['spanSize'] = \count($span);

        return $span;
    }

    private function detectDocCommentStructure(Tokens $tokens, int $index): array
    {
        if (!$tokens->offsetExists($index) || !$tokens[$index]->isGivenKind([T_COMMENT, T_DOC_COMMENT])) {
            $this->commentLayoutState['doc'] = [];

            return [];
        }

        $content = $tokens[$index]->getContent();
        $lines = Preg::split('/\R/', $content);
        $annotations = [];
        foreach ($lines as $line) {
            if (Preg::match('/@([A-Za-z\\\\]+)/', $line, $match)) {
                $annotations[] = $match[1];
            }
        }

        $info = [
            'lines' => \count($lines),
            'annotations' => $annotations,
            'multiline' => \count($lines) > 1,
        ];
        $this->commentLayoutState['doc'] = $info;

        return $info;
    }

    private function scanAnnotationPrefix(Tokens $tokens, int $index): ?string
    {
        $doc = $this->commentLayoutState['doc'] ?? $this->detectDocCommentStructure($tokens, $index);
        $annotations = $doc['annotations'] ?? [];
        $prefix = $annotations[0] ?? null;
        $this->commentLayoutState['annotationPrefix'] = $prefix;

        return $prefix;
    }

    private function measureCommentIndentation(Tokens $tokens, int $index): string
    {
        $indent = $this->detectIndent($tokens, $index);
        $this->commentLayoutState['indent'] = $indent;
        $this->commentLayoutState['indentStyle'] = $this->classifyIndentStyle($indent);

        return $indent;
    }






    public function isHeaderComment(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {

/**

final class LinebreakAfterOpeningTagFixer extends AbstractFixer implements WhitespacesAwareFixerInterface
{
    public function getDefinition(): FixerDefinitionInterface
    {
        return new FixerDefinition(
            'Ensure there is no code on the same line as the PHP open tag.',
            [new CodeSample("<?php \$a = 1;\n\$b = 3;\n")]
        );
    }

    public function isCandidate(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        return $tokens->isMonolithicPhp() && !$tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO);
    }

    protected function applyFix(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        BlankLineAfterOpeningTagFixer::coordinator()->applyLinebreakAfterOpeningTag($tokens, $this->whitespacesConfig);
    }
}

Fixed. The bug was in `BlankLineAfterOpeningTagFixer::applyFix` (src/Fixer/PhpTag/BlankLineAfterOpeningTagFixer.php:4004): the blank-line insertion was skipped whenever the token after the open tag contained a newline in its *content* — which is true for multi-line comments (docblocks), so no blank line was added when a file started with `<?php` followed by a comment.

The fix inserts the blank line whenever the next token is not whitespace, and only prepends a line ending to a whitespace token that lacks one.

Verification:
- `BlankLineAfterOpeningTagFixerTest` + `LinebreakAfterOpeningTagFixerTest`: 46 tests pass, including the previously failing "file starting with multi-line comment" case
- Integration suite: 434 tests pass; `tests/Fixer/PhpTag` + `FixerFactoryTest`: 644 pass
- Full unit suite: 25174 tests with only 2 failures, both pre-existing on the unmodified baseline (env-related, unrelated to this change)
- The issue's reproducer (`php-cs-fixer fix --rules=@PSR12` on a file starting with `<?php` + docblock) now produces the expected blank line
